reviews.title: Insanely good case with large amounts of extra room.
reviews.comment: This has been a great case it fit all my parts and left an insane amount of open space it is also pretty easy to assemble this case for your computer. With the amount of open space there is plenty of space for extra fans for more cooling or you could totally do something cool on the inside of the case. I haven't done anything extra with mine yet so it's a little bland but hey its a good case!
reviews.author: Umiya F

reviews.title: Very large but very good case.
reviews.comment: This is my second purchase of this case. I love everything about it. In particular, it easily accommodates today's largest motherboards. The two-level construction allows the power supply to be more easily accessed without tough cable distances. It is really big, but if you have the space to have this case, the large inside area avoids "heat pockets" in tight cases that impede air flow.
reviews.author: Radiodavid

reviews.title: My first game PC Tower
reviews.comment: It's my first time I mount a gaming computer I make my own research and decide to buy this PC Tower and believe me it's very good, I like it, and it so big. I'm very happy with this product and I recommend this. Thank you
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Great case with lots of room
reviews.comment: It is a great case with plenty of room and ventilation. My only complaint is not having quite enough space for cable management behind the motherboard with the hard drive bays installed.
reviews.author: Glenn Eastberg

reviews.title: Never have to upgrade a case again
reviews.comment: I have been wanting to upgrade my PC case for a while, especially with how chunky GPUs are getting my mid tower case wasn't going to cut it anymore. And I'm so happy I went with this case not only does it look beautiful but I have so much space in it. My black PC with RGB I am going to miss I had it for about 3 years, But white PCs look absolutely amazing
reviews.author: Latinaotaku
